# Hermes Startup Fixture DOX

## Purpose

- Hold captured Hermes terminal startup screens used as golden inputs for runner composer-visibility detection.

## Local Contracts

- Each capture is one detection case: `composer-up.txt` must detect as composer-visible; `welcome-line-no-composer.txt` and `tip-line-no-composer.txt` must detect as not ready. Replace a capture only in the same change as the detection behavior it verifies.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files.
